_about: Project file for Sichttest. Copy to <your repo>/.sichttest/sichttest.projekt.json. All paths are relative to the repo root (the folder above .sichttest). Keys starting with _ are ignored; delete what you do not need. Specification: docs/Specification.md, section 7.
_anwendung: Name your application reports in sts_konfig.anwendung / Steuerung::lade(). Lists without their own **Anwendung:** line use it.
_start: How the tool starts the application if none has connected yet in this session. Remove to start it by hand.
_listen: Folders (or single files) with lists. ablage = where test logs, reports, screenshots and testergebnisse.sqlite go. muster = optional file pattern. A folder that does not exist is skipped silently.
_gewichtung: Switches the retest indicator on (even with empty arrays). hand = files you maintain (template: templates/test-gewichtung.json); git = files the git hook writes, local to the machine, not versioned. hand[i] belongs to git[i].
_abbildung: Only needed if your JSON lists use the fields setup.*, tab, restart, sql, test_db, test_db.ende, or if you want your own link schemes. Value: action name, then the keys passed on as arguments. fortgesetzt is filled by the tool (true when the run is being resumed). wenn=<state> ties a teardown to a state your application reports.
